shared_elements: large upright monolithic stone slab with roughly tapering/rounded top
shallow low-relief carving on a flat frontal face
motifs stacked vertically down the face
curved or rounded arc-like relief bands crossing the stone
justification: Both are tall monolithic stones bearing shallow, low-relief motifs arranged in a vertical sequence down a broad flat frontal face, which gives a comparable first impression of a standing carved pillar. The subject matter and carving manner differ sharply, however: A shows flat, linear animal silhouettes (a quadruped in profile with elongated serpentine forms) confined to a recessed rectangular panel, while B is a modelled anthropomorphic figure with a defined head, encircling disc and horizontal belt-like bands wrapping a rounded, sculptural body.
